title: UX-035 actual dialog boundaries with step evidence

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given USER-A has the dialog labelled "User Profile" on the Home page visible above a workspace with scrollable fixture content
2. When USER-A clicks the button labelled "Maximize" in the dialog with title text "User Profile" on the Home page
3. Then The button labelled "Maximize" in the dialog with title text "User Profile" on the Home page has selected state equal to true
4. When USER-A clicks the button labelled "Maximize" in the dialog with title text "User Profile" on the Home page
5. Then The button labelled "Maximize" in the dialog with title text "User Profile" on the Home page has selected state equal to false
6. When USER-A clicks the chip labelled "Close" in the dialog with title text "User Profile" on the Home page
7. Then The dialog labelled "User Profile" on the Home page is hidden
8. When USER-A scrolls the tabpanel with fixture identifier "WS-SCROLL" on the Home page
9. Then The workspace scroll offset is greater than its value before the final scroll

annotations.description: Actual portal Profile and exported Dialog components. A controlled SystemJS module supplies the declared isolated dialog or scrollable content. This run checks component behavior; the fixture content is not business output.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
